 Paris Saint-Germain carry the weight of five consecutive Ligue 1 wins into Stade Océane, where Le Havre have found home comforts in short supply. The gap in the table is stark — 13 points and a +7 goal differential for the visitors against 5 points and a flat goal difference for the hosts — but the numbers only tell part of the story. Le Havre showed something at Marseille, clawing back from 4-0 down to make it 4-3 before the final whistle. That kind of refusal to fold is worth noting.
 For PSG, Ferran Torres has been the standout attacker with 4 goals and 8 shots on target through five league matches, while Marquinhos has contributed an unexpected 3 goals from the back. Le Havre’s own Josh Maja leads his side with 3 goals, and Rassoul N’Diaye has been quietly busy creating chances — 13 on the season — giving Didier Digard’s side at least some attacking currency to work with against the league’s best.

 Game Preview
 PSG sit at the summit of Ligue 1 with 13 points from five matches, their +7 goal differential reflecting a side that has been scoring freely across France. Le Havre, eighth in the table with 5 points and a neutral goal difference, need results at home to stabilize their position. PSG have found the net in each of their last 14 away league matches — 28 goals across that run — which frames the defensive challenge facing Le Havre clearly. Stade Océane has not been a fortress; the hosts have scored only twice at home in Ligue 1 this season.
 What to Watch For
 Ferran Torres is the player PSG opponents most need to account with 4 goals and 8 shots on target already this season. He is not working alone — Khvicha Kvaratskhelia has 1 goal, 1 assist, and 10 chances created, while Désire Doué matches that with 1 goal, 1 assist, 10 chances created, and 7 shots on target. The depth of PSG’s attacking threat makes single-player containment essentially impossible.
 For Le Havre, Josh Maja’s 3 goals make him the focal point of whatever the hosts can build going forward. Behind him, Sota Nakamura has created 10 chances and contributed 1 assist, and Amir Richardson has generated 7 chances while putting 5 shots on target — players working hard to manufacture something in difficult circumstances. If Le Havre are to find a result, those two will need to keep supplying Maja with the kind of service that gives him a chance to add to his tally against the league’s top side.
